summary: In the second design meeting, the team adjusted the remote control specifications to meet updated project requirements. The team adopted a rechargeable battery with a docking station to minimize device thickness. A flip-top model with an ergonomically curved body was approved, featuring essential controls on the exterior and advanced buttons inside. To address frequent user loss of remotes, a beeper alarm triggered from the docking station will be included, while speech recognition and teletext were formally dropped to control costs. Marketing was assigned to research simplified, user-friendly instruction manual designs before the next meeting.
decisions: Adopted a rechargeable battery paired with a docking station instead of bulky AAA batteries
Approved an ergonomic flip-top casing design with a curved profile and corner corporate logo
Separated controls into basic exterior buttons and secondary interior programming buttons
Integrated an acoustic beeper alarm triggered from the dock/TV to locate misplaced remotes
Formally eliminated teletext support and speech recognition to reduce manufacturing costs

action_items.task: Research simplified and user-friendly formats for the product instruction manual
